    The free linear category on a quiver #

    This constructs a linear category whose objects are the vertices of a quiver and whose morphisms are finite linear combinations of paths. The construction uses the representable projective quiver representations, so associativity and linearity of composition come from the functor category. It is adapted from the Tau Ceti-derived quiver foundation used by the sibling subcat-research formalization, with only the path-category interface retained here.
